name: Insane Gangster Satan Disciples
description: The Insane Gangster Satan Disciples (IGSDN) are a Latino (Mexican) Folk Nation street gang founded around 1959 in North Lawndale, Chicago at 15th and Talman by 'King Satan' (Ray). Originally formed by young boys to defend against rival gangs in the racially changing neighborhood, they adopted both the 'Insane' and 'Gangster' monikers and formed the Insane alliance with the Two Two Boys and Two Six in 1978. The gang grew to an estimated 10,000 members with territory across Brighton Park, Heart of Chicago, Marquette Park, West Town, and surrounding suburbs.
